$comment: Varrock West bank life (plugins/bots/ge/GeHub.PlayerBots.js, the same code as the GE). Everything not set here comes from bot-ge.json (extends): outfits, levels, recipes, pets, chat. A few skillers at the booths (fletching, alching, glassblowing), one or two smithers walking between the bank and the anvils just south, and a bank-stander or two. ::varrockbots (owner) shows what it's doing. Every bot-bank-*.json in this folder is started the same way, so another bank is a copy of this file with its own id, command, approxCenter and counts.
title: Varrock West bank

smithing.$comment: Smithers stand beside an anvil near the bank (anvilSearchRadius tiles from approxCenter; or list them in anvils: [{x, y}]) and smith their best bar into these anvil products, by weight, then walk to a booth to bank. intervalTicks is per item (5, as in game).

teleporters.$landingSpots: Where a replacement bot arrives (the Varrock teleport), then walks to the bank.

smither: addy plates are actually decent xp
